question: Under whose reign and through the efforts of which minister was the French East India Company (Compagnie des Indes Orientales) established in 1664?
explanation: The French East India Company was created in 1664 during the reign of King Louis XIV, through the efforts of his finance minister, Jean-Baptiste Colbert.

question: Which body served as the supreme judicial and administrative council in Pondicherry, assisting the Governor-General in local governance?
explanation: The Conseil Supérieur (Superior Council) was established at Pondicherry to serve as the highest judicial body and administrative council, working alongside the French governor-general.
